doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Buttsy Miller, his brother, and his decline
summary: They discuss William Miller called Buttsy; Burns's brother Tom says he lost his mind through drink.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I don't know if Son's dead. I mean, I don't think Buttsy's dead, but I believe Son's dead. But, uh, nobody wrote and told me about him being dead. And I asked about Buttsy. Oh, Buttsy's son is dead. Yeah. I asked about Buttsy, but Buttsy ain't dead. Him.

No, he's dead. What's his real name, Buttsy? Well, that's every damn thing I ever know. Yeah, I know him for everybody. Yeah, that's the only name I ever know is Buttsy. And Son Miller? Buttsy Miller. And, so he had a, his name was William. His name after his dad. William Miller. William Miller.
Yeah. Do you know where he's living?

I don't know if he dead or what, Son. I mean, uh. Buttsy. Yes. No, Buttsy living. I know he is, because I was just down there four or five months ago. And I asked about New Orleans, but where he at. I don't know. I don't know where he lived. He lived there, I don't know. Because my brother Tom was telling me that Buttsy was crossing the street in front of him. He said, you know, Buttsy act like you're going crazy. I said, what's the matter? He said, he's crossing the street and he's crossing and he got right, right, my car was got right, right close to him, like closer than that door. Yeah. And he stepped off the car and started crossing the street. I said, what? He said, yeah. And then he stopped and he blowed his arm. He said, what the hell is wrong with you, Buttsy? I said, oh, I didn't see you, Tom. He said, actually, you're going to lose his mind or something. That's what he told me. My brother told me that just when I was down there. Yeah. Because I asked about him, you know, I said, was he still living? He said, yeah, Buttsy's living. I think he told me his son did. Yeah. Buttsy's living, but he's crazy. He lost his mind, wrecks a damn much wine and stuff.
Well, that's what he told me to be, to tell me. Mm-hmm.
